authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism in fur texture, lighting, and background depth. However, critical structural artifacts undermine authenticity: (1) The metal frame exhibits illogical bar mergers without welds or joints, violating manufacturing physics; (2) Bear paws lack claw definition and appear smoothed/human-like; (3) Rightmost bear's hind leg-to-torso transition shows biologically questionable proportions. These are not minor texture issues but fundamental structural/anatomical failures. The animal_pose_auditor reported MINIMAL risk (only 1 low-confidence keypoint at 0.2184), but this expert cannot detect texture fusion or structural logic errors—its blind spot aligns precisely with the observed paw smoothing and frame collapse. Thus, the pose auditor's clean bill does not contradict the visible artifacts.
key_defects: Count mismatch: 1 toy structure instead of 6
Structural collapse in metal frame (illogical merging of bars without joints)
Anatomical smoothing on bear paws (lack of distinct claws, human-like appearance)
Biologically questionable hind leg proportions on rightmost bear
